name: denoising-dirty-documents
description: Write a Python fit_predict(train, test_inputs, time_budget_s) function that learns from 144 noisy/clean NoisyOffice document image pairs and returns a cleaned image (intensities on a 0-1 scale) for each of 72 noisy test images of an unseen text passage, within a 300 s wall-clock budget on 4 CPU threads; scored by pixel RMSE against the clean pages (lower is better).

sources.locator: NoisyOffice (Espana-Boquera, Pastor-Pellicer, Castro-Bleda, Zamora-Martinez; CC BY 4.0): SimulatedNoisyOffice noisy and clean grey-level images
prepare.py (ground truth = clean grey level / 255) and grade.py (RMSE over all pixels)
competition definition; its acknowledgement names the NoisyOffice authors and the UCI repository

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: Kaggle dataset access and competition terms
Paper reports gold medal; metric and runtime depend on each competition. Configure competition ID in supplied task config.

Exact metric verified against official MLE-bench grade.py at https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/blob/507f92e1138bb6e40dac5c6ee7a6758e6424bf97/mlebench/competitions/denoising-dirty-documents/grade.py. This dependency revision was audited; LoongFlow paper did not pin this MLE-bench revision.
